title: Strichartz estimates for Schrödinger equations with nonlinear boundary interactions
summary: We study a Schrödinger equation in the upper half-space with a nonlinear Neumann boundary interaction driven by the Bessel operator $\Ba$, $a>-1$. The problem arises naturally as an extension formulation for a nonlocal NLS with memory and can also be interpreted as a Schrödinger evolution with a nonlinear singular source concentrated on a codimension-one interface. We first develop a complete linear theory for the associated inhomogeneous problem with nonhomogeneous Neumann data.
